753:t_125:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't talk like it's over just because you say so! We've still got plenty of fight left in us!」

753:t_125:2.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$ダイ・ガード$$ was built to take on the $$ヘテロダイン$$, after all.」

753:t_125:3.en:
$$青山$$
「Even if we take you down, if there are still $$界震$$s, we'll just sortie again.」

753:t_125:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will end those days myself. That is the supreme salvation.」

753:t_125:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Your pushy goodwill is nothing but unwanted meddling!」

753:t_125:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「We'll live life to the fullest by our own strength! Even if our opponent is the universe, we'll fight desperately and keep on living!」

753:t_125:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You should know your place...」

753:t_125:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'm sick of hearing that line! Now that we've come this far, it doesn't matter if you're a salaryman or a soldier!」

753:t_125:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll stop you, the enemy of all life!」

753:t_125:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'll teach you, self-proclaimed god! Even a salaryman can protect peace... protect the future!!」

753:t_126:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I would like to refute your childish salvation, but unfortunately, we are out of time.」

753:t_126:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I'm disappointed in you, $$ロジャー$$. Do you intend to abandon your duty?」

753:t_126:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I am a professional. I take pride in my duty.」

753:t_126:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The job I accepted is to negotiate with the world... In other words, to keep the world everyone lives in in existence.」

753:t_126:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「As a professional, I take the best possible action to carry out the job... I have simply seen through the fact that words do not reach a self-righteous being like you.」

753:t_126:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Therefore, by the law of $$ロジャー$$, I will stop you and save this universe from collapse!」

753:t_126:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How sad. Your last memory will be the regret of having failed to complete the job.」

753:t_126:7.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Is that so? I can't picture $$ロジャー$$ failing.」

753:t_126:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thank you, $$ドロシー#bigo$$. You do understand me, after all.」

753:t_126:9.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Because that is my duty... no, my wish.」

753:t_126:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then let's go, $$ドロシー#bigo$$! To carry out the job, you and I and $$ビッグオー$$!」

753:t_126:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ビッグオー$$! Final Action!!」

753:t_127:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How sad, $$アポロ$$. To throw away your life to avenge the regret of the $$堕天翅$$.」

753:t_127:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I fight because I can't forgive a guy like you.」

753:t_127:2.en:
$$シリウス$$
「One who gives up on everything without ever facing hardship must not be allowed to call himself a god!」

753:t_127:3.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Anyone who can calmly watch life being lost right before their eyes is the enemy of us... no, of all life!」

753:t_127:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Human and $$天翅$$, man and woman... they are melting into one inside the Mechanical $$天翅$$...!」

753:t_127:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「That is what will strike you down! To bring a future to this universe!」

753:t_127:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'll show you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! The wishes of every living being, gathered across vast ages!」

753:t_127:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Now, $$アクエリオン$$ carves open the future! By breaking through an eternity like you!!」

753:t_128:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is nothing to fear, $$アマタ$$. You and $$ミコノ$$ will be reborn in a new world, and be united there.」

753:t_128:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will guide you both in your next life so that it comes to pass. So...」

753:t_128:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What are you saying...」

753:t_128:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Who do you think you are!? Do you think anyone wants love that somebody else decided for them!」

753:t_128:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I get it now! You don't understand hearts, feelings, or love at all!」

753:t_128:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's why you can accept hearing that the universe will be destroyed with a smile!」

753:t_128:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is not so. All of it is because I have resolved to become a god.」

753:t_128:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Even if you truly became a god, I... we will never accept it!」

753:t_128:11.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's go, $$ミコノ$$! To defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_128:12.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I can't let that guy, who doesn't understand how to love, have my future with $$ミコノ$$... the future of the universe!!」

753:t_129:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$カイエン$$... If you look at the future with your precognition, you will surely feel inclined to quietly accept my salvation.」

753:t_129:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you deny your own power?」

753:t_129:3.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I will carve out the future I want with my own hands!」

753:t_129:4.en:
$$カイエン$$
「You, who stand in its way, I will defeat with these hands! That is my fight!!」

753:t_130:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ミコノ$$... You will be united with your beloved $$アマタ$$ in the new world. So there is nothing to fear.」

753:t_130:1.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't want a next life! What I want is a future walking together with $$アマタ$$!」

753:t_130:2.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You, who get in the way of that, are the enemy of everyone who loves!」

753:t_130:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Anger does not suit you. What is asked of an apostle of love is a sweet, lovely smile.」

753:t_130:4.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「With arbitrary assumptions like that, you keep taking away other people's happiness!」

753:t_130:5.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I will fight a person like that...! I'm one of the $$エレメント$$s too!」

753:t_130:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Lend me your strength, $$アマタ$$! To protect the world we love!」

753:t_130:8.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Together with $$アマタ$$, I will fight you!!」

753:t_131:0.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Let's do this! This big showdown, I'll settle it with my digging power!」

753:t_131:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That single-mindedness of yours is endearing, $$アンディ$$.」

753:t_131:2.en:
$$アンディ$$
「I've got no taste for being happy when a guy says that to me! $$ＭＩＸ$$ is the only one I'd love even if she turned into a guy!」

753:t_131:4.en:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm always dead serious! To protect the world where I live with you, I'll put my life on the line, $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

753:t_131:6.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Get ready, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll punch a huge hole in that precious Supreme God of yours!!」

753:t_132:0.en:
$$モロイ$$
「This is the battle that decides the fate of the universe! If this doesn't fire you up, you're no man!」

753:t_132:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is a fine fighting spirit, $$モロイ$$.」

753:t_132:2.en:
$$モロイ$$
「As expected of a self-proclaimed god. I'm touched that you even know about a slightly plain guy like me.」

753:t_132:3.en:
$$モロイ$$
「But I'll show no mercy! For everyone who entrusted their hope to us, I'll win this fight!!」

753:t_133:0.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Looks like there's no lie in what you say about saving the universe.」

753:t_133:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You smelled out the truth by instinct. As expected, $$カグラ$$.」

753:t_133:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「But listen! I've got no intention of accepting your way of doing things!」

753:t_133:3.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That smile of yours...! That grin, like you think we're nothing but bugs, is what pisses me off!」

753:t_133:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're just a stray dog after all... But your howling does not reach me...!」

753:t_133:5.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Then I'll sink my teeth into your throat! Get ready, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_134:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ジン$$ of $$アルテア$$... You have survived, transcending causality. I recommend you meet your final moment quietly.」

753:t_134:1.en:
$$ジン$$
「The reason I've been able to live until today is that I wished to live for $$ユノハ$$!」

753:t_134:3.en:
$$ジン$$
「So I'll fight until my final moment! Even if my opponent is fate, or a god!」

753:t_134:4.en:
$$ジン$$
「Lend me your strength, $$ユノハ$$! So that we can seize the future by surpassing $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_135:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ゼシカ$$... Even you, who lost in love, will surely be able to find a different love in a new world.」
